data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence and parameters, but it ends with "Send" where the true workflow says never to send and to Discard, and it hardcodes the 19:30 slot, drops the "review score ≥ 8" filter, and leaves the Viator and OpenTable do-not-click constraints unstated, so an automation built from it would send a real email and could pick the wrong hotel.
